facts.fact: The National Identification Registry (NIR) Act of 2011, an Act of the Legislature approved by the President on 1 August 2011 and published 8 August 2011, repeals PRC Decree #65 of 1983 and sets up the National Identification Registry, which runs the National Biometric Identification System; its text says it takes effect on publication.
facts.system: National Identification Registry (NIR) Act of 2011 (National Biometric Identification System)

facts.fact: The Act's own text sets up a National Biometric Identification System and a biometric card for each person (fingerprint and photograph enrolled, data encrypted) carrying a unique Social Security Number as the primary government identity number, with enrolment mandatory for citizens.
facts.system: National Identification Registry (NIR) Act of 2011 (National Biometric Identification System)

systems.tiers: citizens and residents; banking, social benefits and traffic transactions
